title: How the Birth Control Pill Got Over the Counter

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是 Benjamin Poulin，我是 Mark Ronson，欢迎收听《The Reframers》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店里用黑胶唱片打碟的那个年代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着 300 件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，把 DJ 台变成了一个充满 50 年历史精美文物的流动博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《The Reframers》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowev.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的 Natalie Kittrowev。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《The Daily》节目。

sentences.en: Last week, for the first time in U.S.
sentences.zh: 上周，美国历史上首次，

sentences.en: history, federal regulators approved the sale of a birth control pill without a prescription.
sentences.zh: 联邦监管机构批准了无需处方即可销售避孕药。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Pam Bellick on why, after decades of brutal battles over contraception, this decision played out so differently.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事 Pam Bellick 将带我们了解，为何在经历了数十年的避孕问题激烈交锋后，这次的决策过程却截然不同。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, July 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 7 月 19 日，星期三。

sentences.en: So Pam, when I saw this news story pop up that the birth control pill had been approved to be sold over the counter for the first time,
sentences.zh: Pam，当我看到这则避孕药首次获批非处方销售的新闻时，

sentences.en: I imagine that there was some sort of story of a bruising battle between reproductive rights groups and social conservatives who have typically been opposed to things like abortion and contraception.
sentences.zh: 我以为这背后会有一场生殖权利团体与通常反对堕胎和避孕的社会保守派之间激烈的博弈。

sentences.en: But then we called you, and you said, nope, this was actually a very uncontentious fight that just played out.
sentences.zh: 但当我们联系你时，你说不，这其实是一场非常平淡、顺理成章的斗争。

sentences.en: So I am surprised and confused.
sentences.zh: 所以我感到很惊讶也很困惑。

sentences.en: Help me.
sentences.zh: 帮帮我。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, it was really striking to me, too, that when this thing kind of got to the point of a decision being made,
sentences.zh: 是啊，其实我也觉得很震惊，当这件事真正到了要做决定的时候，

sentences.en: there was overwhelming support and even pressure from many people to get this approved.
sentences.zh: 各方给予了压倒性的支持，甚至有很多人施压要求批准。

sentences.en: And the conservative voices that are typically against this were very quiet.
sentences.zh: 而那些通常反对避孕的保守派声音却非常安静。

sentences.en: And given how controversial and how much of a flashpoint contraception has been over the decades, this was a really interesting moment.
sentences.zh: 考虑到几十年来避孕问题是多么具有争议性和爆发性，这确实是一个非常有趣的时刻。

sentences.en: It was really notable that in this case, you didn't have a lot of strong voices opposing it.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，在这种情况下，你并没有听到太多强烈的反对声音。

sentences.en: So, Pam, what is the beginning of this story?
sentences.zh: 那么，Pam，这个故事的开端是什么？

sentences.en: How did we get here?
sentences.zh: 我们是怎么走到这一步的？

sentences.en: So the birth control pill was developed mostly in the 1950s, and it was approved first by the FDA in 1960.
sentences.zh: 避孕药主要是在 20 世纪 50 年代研发出来的，并于 1960 年首次获得 FDA 批准。

sentences.en: They come in big bottles for a year's supply, smaller bottles for a month's supply and handy calendar packs.
sentences.zh: 它们有供一年使用的大瓶装、供一个月使用的小瓶装，还有方便的日历包装。

sentences.en: It was absolutely groundbreaking for women and for reproductive health.
sentences.zh: 这对女性和生殖健康来说绝对是开创性的。

sentences.en: How effective is it?
sentences.zh: 它的效果如何？

sentences.en: If taken 100%.
sentences.zh: 如果百分之百按要求服用的话。

sentences.en: You know, there was really nothing else out there that was as effective that people could obtain.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当时确实没有其他同样有效且人们能获取到的避孕方式了。

sentences.en: You know, it's much more effective than condoMs.
sentences.zh: 它比避孕套有效得多。

sentences.en: It stops ovulation, so there is no egg.
sentences.zh: 它能阻止排卵，所以不会有卵子产生。

sentences.en: And for the first time, women were able to control their own reproductive choices, and they were able to take control of when they wanted to get pregnant.
sentences.zh: 女性第一次能够掌控自己的生殖选择，能够自主决定何时怀孕。

sentences.en: And so it becomes a huge influence in women being able to go into the workforce, to be able to control how many children they have.
sentences.zh: 因此，它对女性进入职场、控制生育子女的数量产生了巨大的影响。

sentences.en: And it really is just transformative for American society.
sentences.zh: 它确实彻底改变了美国社会。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It sounds like it's not an exaggeration to say that in giving women more control over when they get pregnant, the pill really transforms their lives.
sentences.zh: 听起来说它让女性对何时怀孕有了更多掌控权，从而彻底改变了她们的生活，这并不夸张。

sentences.en: It allows them to work for longer.
sentences.zh: 它让她们能工作更长时间。

sentences.en: It leads to the kind of gender picture in the job market that we have today, which is closer to parity than it was half a century ago.
sentences.zh: 它带来了我们今天所看到的就业市场性别格局，比半个世纪前更接近平等。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a catalyst for pretty broad changes.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它是引发广泛变革的催化剂。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But, of course, there was a backlash.
sentences.zh: 但当然，也出现了反弹。

sentences.en: In the 1960s, you had the Pope and Catholic leaders opposing birth control, except for the Rhythm Method.
sentences.zh: 在 20 世纪 60 年代，教皇和天主教领袖反对避孕，除了“安全期避孕法”之外。

sentences.en: You also had a branch of the NAACP and later other Black leaders registering opposition as well,
sentences.zh: 全国有色人种协进会（NAACP）的一个分支以及后来的其他黑人领袖也表达了反对意见，

sentences.en: because they were concerned that this was going to be used as a tool to try to keep the Black population down.
sentences.zh: 因为他们担心这会被用作压制黑人人口的工具。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And there was some history that they drew on to sort of support that, because the development of the pill was in part funded by people who supported eugenics.
sentences.zh: 他们引用了一些历史来支持这种观点，因为避孕药的研发在一定程度上是由支持优生学的人资助的。

sentences.en: And the first birth control pill clinical trials were conducted in Puerto Rico among women who were relatively poor.
sentences.zh: 而且第一批避孕药临床试验是在波多黎各的相对贫困的女性群体中进行的。

sentences.en: So that sort of feeds into what's going on here in the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 所以这在某种程度上助长了 20 世纪 60 年代发生的事情。

sentences.en: And then, interestingly, there was also a bit of a feminist backlash.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，当时还出现了一些来自女权主义者的反弹。

sentences.en: There were concerns being raised about the health side effects of the pill.
sentences.zh: 人们对避孕药的健康副作用表示担忧。

sentences.en: None of them were very, very severe.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有一个是特别严重的。

sentences.en: But the idea that you have generally a white male medical establishment, you know,
sentences.zh: 但那种由白人男性主导的医疗机构在推广女性使用的避孕药的做法，

sentences.en: kind of promoting birth control that women would use fed into concerns that feminists were having about the patriarchy and whether men were basically trying to tell women what to do.
sentences.zh: 助长了女权主义者对父权制的担忧，以及对男性是否在试图控制女性行为的质疑。

sentences.en: So the pill is facing opposition from different quarters.
sentences.zh: 所以避孕药面临着来自不同方面的反对。

sentences.en: And at the same time, American women are interested in oral contraceptives.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，美国女性对口服避孕药很感兴趣。

sentences.en: It's getting increasingly popular.
sentences.zh: 它正变得越来越受欢迎。

sentences.en: There's growing demand for it.
sentences.zh: 需求在不断增长。

sentences.en: It is estimated that perhaps one out of every three American women married between the age of 15 and 44 has used or is using the oral contraceptives.
sentences.zh: 据估计，在 15 到 44 岁之间已婚的美国女性中，可能有三分之一已经或正在使用口服避孕药。

sentences.en: And as with all thorny issues in American society.
sentences.zh: 正如美国社会所有棘手的问题一样。

sentences.en: Number 496, Estelle T.
sentences.zh: 第 496 号案件，Estelle T.

sentences.en: Griswold et al.
sentences.zh: Griswold 等人，

sentences.en: Appellants v.
sentences.zh: 上诉人诉，

sentences.en: Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 康涅狄格州。

sentences.en: This one gets catapulted to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 这个案子被推到了最高法院。

sentences.en: Chief Justice, may it please the court.
sentences.zh: 首席大法官，请允许我发言。

sentences.en: This case involves the validity of the Connecticut anti-contraceptive statutes.
sentences.zh: 本案涉及康涅狄格州反避孕法规的有效性。

sentences.en: And the Supreme Court makes one very key decision in 1965 that says that there's a constitutional right to contraception for married couples.
sentences.zh: 最高法院在 1965 年做出了一个非常关键的裁决，称已婚夫妇拥有宪法保障的避孕权。

sentences.en: Mr. Chief Justice.
sentences.zh: 首席大法官先生。

sentences.en: And then later in 1972.
sentences.zh: 后来在 1972 年。

sentences.en: What happens if this statute is held constitutional to children already?
sentences.zh: 如果这项法规被认定符合宪法，对已经出生的孩子会怎样？

sentences.en: The next birth.
sentences.zh: 下一次生育。

sentences.en: It says, you know what, that constitutional right applies to everybody.
sentences.zh: 法院裁定，那种宪法权利适用于所有人。

sentences.en: And so at this point, you know, there had been some states, I think about half the states in the 1960s had outlawed contraception.
sentences.zh: 所以在那时，我想 20 世纪 60 年代大约有一半的州取缔了避孕措施。

sentences.en: But all of that goes away.
sentences.zh: 但这一切都消失了。

sentences.en: And there becomes a constitutional right to have access to contraception.
sentences.zh: 人们获得了获取避孕措施的宪法权利。

sentences.en: And that paves the way for even more popularity of the pill.
sentences.zh: 这为避孕药的进一步普及铺平了道路。

sentences.en: And that 1972 decision on contraception comes a year before Roe, right, when the Supreme Court says there's a constitutional right to abortion.
sentences.zh: 而 1972 年关于避孕的裁决是在“罗诉韦德案”前一年做出的，对吧？当时最高法院裁定堕胎拥有宪法权利。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's really a time period of major change.
sentences.zh: 那确实是一个发生重大变革的时期。

sentences.en: And big barriers to contraception, to reproductive health access are being upended.
sentences.zh: 避孕和生殖健康获取方面的巨大障碍正在被推翻。

sentences.en: So you have millions of American women taking the pill.
sentences.zh: 所以你有数百万美国女性在服用避孕药。

sentences.en: Even majorities of American Catholics are using contraception and some of them are using the pill.
sentences.zh: 甚至大多数美国天主教徒也在使用避孕措施，其中一些人也在使用避孕药。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And by the 80s, you have lots of different companies starting to develop different types of birth control pills.
sentences.zh: 到了 80 年代，许多不同的公司开始开发不同类型的避孕药。

sentences.en: And so there's just a lot of innovation in the field of birth control pills.
sentences.zh: 所以避孕药领域出现了大量的创新。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that innovation is in itself an indication that there's been a meaningful enough break in the opposition to contraception
sentences.zh: 这种创新本身就表明，对避孕措施的反对已经有了实质性的缓解，

sentences.en: and the birth control pill specifically, that these companies see a real market there that they want to get it on.
sentences.zh: 特别是对避孕药的反对，这些公司看到了一个他们想要进入的真正市场。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So by the early 1990s, you have reproductive health experts who are floating this idea of getting a pill that could be available without a prescription.
sentences.zh: 到了 20 世纪 90 年代初，生殖健康专家开始提出一种无需处方即可获得避孕药的想法。

sentences.en: There's even a little burst of discussion with the FDA about this.
sentences.zh: 甚至与 FDA 进行了一小波讨论。

sentences.en: There are academic articles written about this.
sentences.zh: 还有关于此事的学术文章发表。

sentences.en: And so this idea starts to sort of get into the social bloodstream a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以这个想法开始稍微进入了社会主流讨论中。

sentences.en: But at the same time in the 1990s, the issue of abortion starts to really become a more contentious issue with the religious right.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，在 90 年代，堕胎问题开始真正成为宗教右翼更具争议的问题。

sentences.en: And contraception just kind of gets pushed to the side as an issue that people are talking about.
sentences.zh: 避孕问题就被搁置一旁，不再是人们讨论的焦点了。

sentences.en: But the issue of whether a pill should be over the counter is still quietly burning in the background.
sentences.zh: 但关于避孕药是否应该成为非处方药的问题，仍在后台悄悄发酵。

sentences.en: And you have scientists that are doing research.
sentences.zh: 科学家们一直在进行研究。

sentences.en: They're trying to answer some key questions for the medical community.
sentences.zh: 他们试图为医学界回答一些关键问题。

sentences.en: They're trying to make sure that they can document that it's safe to use without a prescription, that it won't keep women from going to the doctor for other reasons,
sentences.zh: 他们试图确保能够证明无需处方使用是安全的，并且不会阻止女性因其他原因去看医生，

sentences.en: like pap smears and things like that.
sentences.zh: 比如宫颈涂片检查之类的。

sentences.en: And by the early 2010s, they have really convinced the medical establishment.
sentences.zh: 到了 2010 年代初，他们确实说服了医学界。

sentences.en: And you have major medical organizations in reproductive health coming out with official statements saying, we think there ought to be an over-the-counter birth control pill.
sentences.zh: 生殖健康领域的主要医学组织发表了官方声明，称我们认为应该有非处方避孕药。

sentences.en: And do their recommendations have an impact on the debate or on policy at this point?
sentences.zh: 那么他们的建议在此时对辩论或政策有影响吗？

sentences.en: Not right away.
sentences.zh: 没有立即产生影响。

sentences.en: And part of that is because at the same time that this is happening, you have other reproductive health fights that are really in the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是，在这一切发生的同时，还有其他生殖健康斗争正处于聚光灯下。

sentences.en: Tonight, I return to speak to all of you about an issue that is central to that future.
sentences.zh: 今晚，我回来与大家谈论一个对未来至关重要的问题。

sentences.en: The Obama administration has come in.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马政府上台了。

sentences.en: And that is the issue of health care.
sentences.zh: 那就是医疗保健问题。

sentences.en: And one of their first priorities is the Affordable Care Act to expand access to health care.
sentences.zh: 他们的首要任务之一就是《平价医疗法案》，以扩大医疗保健的覆盖范围。

sentences.en: And one very controversial aspect of that is that the government mandates coverage of prescription birth control, including prescription birth control pills.
sentences.zh: 其中一个非常有争议的方面是，政府强制要求保险覆盖处方避孕措施，包括处方避孕药。

sentences.en: On January 20th this year, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今年 1 月 20 日，美国

sentences.en: Department of Health and Human Services approved a mandate that will force Catholic employers to violate their consciences and fund practices that to them are morally offensive.
sentences.zh: 卫生与公众服务部批准了一项强制令，将迫使天主教雇主违背良心，资助他们认为在道德上令人反感的行为。

sentences.en: The anti-abortion forces are against that, and they start conflating the birth control pill with abortion and the morning-after pill.
sentences.zh: 反堕胎势力对此表示反对，他们开始将避孕药与堕胎药和事后避孕药混为一谈。

sentences.en: The scope of this mandate included drugs that can prevent the implantation of the new embryo.
sentences.zh: 这项强制令的范围包括可以防止新胚胎植入的药物。

sentences.en: Therefore, in our view, and that of many others, is really abortifacient.
sentences.zh: 因此，在我们和许多其他人看来，这实际上是堕胎药。

sentences.en: They start falsely saying that the morning-after pill is an abortion pill and blending that together with other types of contraception.
sentences.zh: 他们开始错误地宣称事后避孕药是堕胎药，并将其与其他类型的避孕措施混在一起。

sentences.en: And another issue that they have is this concern that making all kinds of reproductive health care more available might encourage teenagers to be more sexually promiscuous.
sentences.zh: 他们担心的另一个问题是，让各种生殖保健服务变得更容易获取，可能会鼓励青少年在性方面更加放纵。

sentences.en: There's no evidence that this is the case, but this is a conservative argument.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有证据表明事实如此，但这确实是一个保守派的论点。

sentences.en: And so all of this really sucks up all the oxygen in this arena, and the idea of trying to get an over-the-counter birth control at this point is kind of a non-starter,
sentences.zh: 所以这一切真的耗尽了这个领域的所有氧气，试图获得非处方避孕药的想法在当时根本行不通，

sentences.en: and nobody brings it up for another few years.
sentences.zh: 好几年都没人再提了。

sentences.en: So this gets drowned out again by the abortion fight?
sentences.zh: 所以它又被堕胎之争淹没了？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It basically recedes from public view, and it doesn't get thrust back into the spotlight until 2022 when Roe v.
sentences.zh: 它基本上从公众视野中消失了，直到 2022 年“罗诉韦德案”被推翻，它才重新回到聚光灯下。

sentences.en: Wade is overturned.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 33 位总统。

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨 4 点 30 分给总统打电话，他接听了。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning, and he answered.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费者产品指南。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 今天，我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: Today, I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 60 款超级圣代。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟中最好的球队。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
53,500 puzzles.
sentences.zh: 我每天都使用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: I use a different starting word every day.
25,000 recipes.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.

sentences.zh: 那么，Pam，在“罗诉韦德案”被推翻后，避孕药是如何重新回到人们视野中的？

sentences.en: So, Pam, what's the story of how the pill comes back into focus once Roe is overturned?
sentences.zh: 事实证明，在 2016 年，一家法国公司与一个美国生殖健康组织建立了合作伙伴关系，

sentences.en: So, it turns out that in 2016, a French company partners with an American reproductive health group,
sentences.zh: 他们决定进行必要的调研和研究，以向 FDA 提交非处方避孕药的审批申请。

sentences.en: and they decide that they are going to do the studies and the research needed to put together an application to the FDA for approval of an over-the-counter pill.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们正在进行所有必要的研究。

sentences.en: And so, they're doing all the studies that they need.
sentences.zh: 当一切准备就绪时，他们在 2022 年 7 月向 FDA 提交了申请。

sentences.en: And at the point where this is all ready, they submit their application to the FDA in July of 2022.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 就在“罗诉韦德案”被推翻后不久。

sentences.en: So, right after Roe is overturned.
sentences.zh: 是的，就像在“罗诉韦德案”被推翻三周后。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's like three weeks after Roe is overturned.
sentences.zh: 这只是时间上的巧合。

sentences.en: And it's a coincidental timing.
sentences.zh: 并不是说他们看到最高法院的裁决后才说，我们要现在提交申请。

sentences.en: It's not like they saw the Supreme Court decision and said, we're going to submit this now.
sentences.zh: 他们只是刚好准备好了。

sentences.en: They were just ready to do that.
sentences.zh: 但这个时间点变得非常重要，因为一半的州开始取消堕胎渠道。

sentences.en: But the timing becomes really important because abortion access starts to get taken away in half of the states.
sentences.zh: 所以这让避孕药的非处方化变得更加紧迫。

sentences.en: And not only that, Justice Clarence Thomas, in a concurring opinion to the decision that overturned Roe,
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，克拉伦斯·托马斯大法官在推翻“罗诉韦德案”裁决的协同意见书中，

sentences.en: starts to raise the prospect that some other Supreme Court precedents might drop away, including the precedent allowing for the right to contraception access.
sentences.zh: 开始提出其他一些最高法院的先例可能会被推翻的可能性，包括允许获得避孕药具权利的先例。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, you get a huge groundswell of concern about contraception, about the need for it, about whether it's going to be taken away.
sentences.zh: 所以，关于避孕、关于避孕的需求、关于避孕措施是否会被取消，引发了巨大的担忧浪潮。

sentences.en: And when the application for this pill comes before the FDA, the public is really paying attention.
sentences.zh: 当这种药丸的申请提交到美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）时，公众确实非常关注。

sentences.en: And how does that manifest?
sentences.zh: 这表现得如何呢？

sentences.en: What does that look like?
sentences.zh: 看起来是什么样子的？

sentences.en: So, the FDA has what's called an advisory committee hearing before they make the decision.
sentences.zh: FDA在做出决定之前会举行所谓的咨询委员会听证会。

sentences.en: And before that, there's a period where people can post comments for the FDA and the advisory committee to see.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，有一个公众可以发表评论的阶段，供FDA和咨询委员会查看。

sentences.en: Usually, you get some pro, some con.
sentences.zh: 通常，你会看到一些赞成和反对的意见。

sentences.en: But in this case, you got hundreds of comments, and almost all of them were in favor of the over-the-counter pill and really saying how necessary it was, especially now.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，你收到了数百条评论，几乎所有评论都支持非处方药丸，并真正说明了它的必要性，尤其是在当下。

sentences.en: Good morning and welcome.
sentences.zh: 早上好，欢迎收听。

sentences.en: And you get that same dynamic at the advisory committee hearing in May, which I listened to.
sentences.zh: 我在五月份旁听了咨询委员会的听证会，那里也出现了同样的态势。

sentences.en: It was a two-day hearing.
sentences.zh: 那是一场为期两天的听证会。

sentences.en: Speaker number 27.
sentences.zh: 第27号发言人。

sentences.en: And there is just a parade of like three dozen people who are speaking about what they want to happen.
sentences.zh: 有大约三打人排着队发言，表达他们希望看到的结果。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: My name is Divi Vitron.
sentences.zh: 我叫迪维·维特隆（Divi Vitron）。

sentences.en: I am 19 years old, and I'm from McAllen, Texas.
sentences.zh: 我今年19岁，来自德克萨斯州的麦卡伦。

sentences.en: When I was 16 years old, I became sexually active.
sentences.zh: 我16岁时开始有性生活。

sentences.en: Coming from a very religious community...
sentences.zh: 来自一个非常保守的宗教社区……

sentences.en: There's some really impassioned and very kind of emotional statements, especially from young people
sentences.zh: 有一些非常热切且感人的陈述，特别是来自年轻人，

sentences.en: who are saying that they had a really hard time getting prescription birth control when they tried.
sentences.zh: 他们说在尝试获取处方避孕药时遇到了很大的困难。

sentences.en: When I finally mustered the courage to open up to my parents and disclose that I needed a new form of contraception to help me feel safe, I was met with a stern no and a grounding.
sentences.zh: 当我终于鼓起勇气向父母坦白，说我需要一种新的避孕方式来让自己感到安全时，我得到的却是严厉的拒绝和禁足。

sentences.en: I was told that if not being given birth control would stop me from being active, then so be it.
sentences.zh: 我被告知，如果不给我避孕药能阻止我进行性行为，那就这样吧。

sentences.en: And so I continued having sex without birth control, all because I could not access it under the prescription-only system.
sentences.zh: 于是我继续在没有避孕措施的情况下进行性行为，这一切都因为我在仅限处方的制度下无法获得避孕药。

sentences.en: So you have young women, teenagers...
sentences.zh: 所以你看到的是年轻女性、青少年……

sentences.en: For too long, I shied away from signing my name on the log to be seen out of fear that I would be judged or seen as irresponsible for seeking control over my reproductive health.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，我因为害怕被评判或被视为不负责任，而不敢在登记簿上签名以寻求对自己生殖健康的控制。

sentences.en: Women of color...
sentences.zh: 有色人种女性……

sentences.en: If O-Pill were available over-the-counter, rural youth could access this life-changing care online with ease.
sentences.zh: 如果O-Pill（口服避孕药）可以作为非处方药购买，农村地区的年轻人就能轻松地在线获得这种改变生活的护理。

sentences.en: For people representing rural communities...
sentences.zh: 对于代表农村社区的人们来说……

sentences.en: I'm asking you to please consider making birth control over-the-counter with no age restrictions.
sentences.zh: 我请求你们考虑将避孕药列为非处方药，且不设年龄限制。

sentences.en: It could be life-changing for many of us.
sentences.zh: 这对我们许多人来说可能是改变一生的事。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: My name is Lisa Haddad, and I'm an OB-GYN with subspecialty training in complex family planning.
sentences.zh: 我叫丽莎·哈达德（Lisa Haddad），是一名妇产科医生，在复杂计划生育方面受过亚专科培训。

sentences.en: There are statements from doctors who are saying...
sentences.zh: 有些医生发表声明说……

sentences.en: While deep and meaningful interactions with health professionals are often helpful to some patients,
sentences.zh: 虽然与医疗专业人员进行深入且有意义的互动对某些患者通常有帮助，

sentences.en: these visits are often brief and are not required before a patient starts to use contraception.
sentences.zh: 但这些就诊往往很简短，而且在患者开始使用避孕药之前并不是必须的。

sentences.en: Look, we prescribe this pill, and we want to cut ourselves out of the process.
sentences.zh: 听着，我们开这种药，但我们想把自己从这个过程中剔除出去。

sentences.en: This will not prevent women from having discussions with providers.
sentences.zh: 这并不会阻止女性与医疗服务提供者进行沟通。

sentences.en: Your decision can help millions to have easier access to effective contraception.
sentences.zh: 你们的决定可以帮助数百万人更容易地获得有效的避孕措施。

sentences.en: We do not see any reason for us to be there writing these prescriptions when it is perfectly safe and much easier for women if they can just pick it off in a CVS or, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们认为没有理由非要由我们来开这些处方，如果女性可以直接在CVS药店，或者你知道，

sentences.en: in a convenience store.
sentences.zh: 在便利店就能买到，这既安全又方便得多。

sentences.en: This is important, necessary, and urgent.
sentences.zh: 这很重要，很有必要，而且很紧迫。

sentences.en: Thank you for your time.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们的时间。

sentences.en: So it's just a very kind of a dramatic and moving series of statements that you don't always get at these kinds of federal hearings.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一系列非常戏剧性和感人的陈述，你在这种联邦听证会上并不总是能听到。

sentences.en: I'm Susan Muscat, president of Pro Family Women, and we oppose this proposal to allow over-the-counter access to the O-PIL contraceptive pill.
sentences.zh: 我是苏珊·马斯喀特（Susan Muscat），“支持家庭妇女组织”（Pro Family Women）的主席，我们反对这项允许非处方购买O-PIL避孕药的提议。

sentences.en: I think there was at least one person who spoke against it.
sentences.zh: 我想至少有一个人发言反对它。

sentences.en: A key issue is whether the FDA will allow minor girls over-the-counter access to O-PIL without their parents' permission.
sentences.zh: 一个关键问题是FDA是否会允许未成年女孩在没有父母许可的情况下非处方购买O-PIL。

sentences.en: I think she was mostly concerned about the issue of whether this would be available to young people and whether they should be still required to get it by prescription.
sentences.zh: 我认为她主要担心的是这是否会对年轻人开放，以及他们是否仍应被要求凭处方获取。

sentences.en: We will now adjourn this meeting.
sentences.zh: 我们现在休会。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: But most anti-abortion groups, most conservative activists were just really not saying anything about this.
sentences.zh: 但大多数反堕胎组织、大多数保守派活动人士对此并没有发表任何意见。

sentences.en: And believe me, they do weigh in on every abortion-related issue very strongly.
sentences.zh: 相信我，他们在每一个与堕胎相关的问题上都会非常强烈地表态。

sentences.en: So it's notable when they're quiet about something, when they're not even really mentioning it.
sentences.zh: 所以当他们对某事保持沉默，甚至几乎不提时，这很值得注意。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what was clear from the public comments was that there was overwhelming support.
sentences.zh: 所以从公众评论中可以清楚地看出，支持的声音是压倒性的。

sentences.en: What was not clear was whether the FDA was actually going to approve this.
sentences.zh: 不清楚的是FDA是否真的会批准它。

sentences.en: They had some safety concerns about whether this was a good idea to make it available over-the-counter.
sentences.zh: 他们对将其作为非处方药是否是个好主意有一些安全方面的顾虑。

sentences.en: But ultimately, they did approve it.
sentences.zh: 但最终，他们还是批准了。

sentences.en: And what they said was the safety concerns that they had might still be there,
sentences.zh: 他们表示，他们所担心的安全问题可能依然存在，

sentences.en: but that they were far outweighed by the public health need and the public health benefit of giving people access to over-the-counter birth control.
sentences.zh: 但与让人们获得非处方避孕药所带来的公共卫生需求和公共卫生利益相比，这些顾虑显得微不足道。

sentences.en: But Pam, what happened to the strong feelings about contraception that we saw during the Obama years and the forces behind them?
sentences.zh: 但是帕姆，我们在奥巴马时期看到的对避孕的强烈情绪以及背后的力量发生了什么？

sentences.en: Why aren't we seeing a bigger backlash?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们没有看到更大的反弹？

sentences.en: Well, I think there are a couple things going on here.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这里有几件事在起作用。

sentences.en: One is that, once again, abortion and the battle over abortion is kind of soaking up a lot of the oxygen and energy on the anti-abortion side.
sentences.zh: 首先，堕胎以及关于堕胎的斗争再次占据了反堕胎阵营的大部分精力和关注。

sentences.en: So even though they won with the Supreme Court decision,
sentences.zh: 所以即使他们在最高法院的裁决中获胜了，

sentences.en: there are a lot of things that they are battling for and trying to protect in the states where anti-abortion laws are being passed.
sentences.zh: 在那些正在通过反堕胎法的州，他们还有很多事情要争取和保护。

sentences.en: And so there's a lot of energy that they're spending trying to do that, and they're also trying to get a national abortion ban.
sentences.zh: 所以他们投入了大量精力试图做到这一点，而且他们还在试图推动全国性的堕胎禁令。

sentences.en: And I think also the popularity of contraception is so great that many people on the conservative side don't really want to take that on.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为避孕措施的普及度非常高，以至于许多保守派人士并不想真的去挑战这一点。

sentences.en: That's not where they want to spend their political capital right now.
sentences.zh: 那不是他们现在想投入政治资本的地方。

sentences.en: So they are choosing not to engage in fighting that right now.
sentences.zh: 所以他们选择现在不参与那场斗争。

sentences.en: So they're both busy pushing the anti-abortion agenda even further, and they see restricting contraception as not really a winning issue because it's so popular.
sentences.zh: 所以他们既忙于进一步推动反堕胎议程，又认为限制避孕并不是一个能赢的议题，因为它太受欢迎了。

sentences.en: And they're kind of saying it's not worth it to focus on that.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得把精力集中在那上面不值得。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And also, for some Republicans, you even have right now in some of the Republican states that are banning abortion,
sentences.zh: 而且，对于一些共和党人来说，即使在现在一些禁止堕胎的共和党州，

sentences.en: some of them are taking small steps to try to expand access to birth control by, say, passing legislation to allow pharmacists to prescribe it
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人正在采取小步骤试图扩大避孕药的获取途径，比如通过立法允许药剂师开处方，

sentences.en: or extending Medicaid coverage to certain types of contraceptives.
sentences.zh: 或者将医疗补助（Medicaid）覆盖范围扩大到某些类型的避孕药具。

sentences.en: Explain that to me.
sentences.zh: 给我解释一下。

sentences.en: Why are Republicans all of a sudden behind expanding contraception?
sentences.zh: 为什么共和党人突然支持扩大避孕措施？

sentences.en: Well, I think there are some Republicans, not all, but some, who see that if you are extinguishing the right to abortion,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为有一些共和党人，不是全部，但有一些人意识到，如果你正在消灭堕胎权，

sentences.en: you really ought to spend more effort trying to prevent unplanned pregnancies.
sentences.zh: 你确实应该投入更多努力去预防意外怀孕。

sentences.en: And logically, of course, if you expand access to contraception, you're going to lower the number of unplanned pregnancies and lower the need for abortion for some people.
sentences.zh: 从逻辑上讲，当然，如果你扩大了避孕措施的获取途径，你就会减少意外怀孕的数量，并减少某些人对堕胎的需求。

sentences.en: So there are some people who are connecting those dots, and I think that's part of the landscape here.
sentences.zh: 所以有些人正在把这些点联系起来，我认为这是当前形势的一部分。

sentences.en: It's fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这太迷人了。

sentences.en: It's like in a country where now abortion is much harder to access, it's becoming harder to make the argument,
sentences.zh: 这就像在一个堕胎变得更加困难的国家，要论证这一点变得越来越难，

sentences.en: to thread that needle that you should not be allowed to have an abortion, and you also shouldn't be allowed to help yourself avoid being in the position where you need one.
sentences.zh: 即你既不应该被允许堕胎，也不应该被允许帮助自己避免陷入需要堕胎的境地。

sentences.en: I think that's true.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是事实。

sentences.en: However, I would also say that, you know, certainly you don't see a lot of Republican leaders
sentences.zh: 然而，我也想说，你知道，当然你并没有看到很多共和党领导人

sentences.en: at the national level coming out and championing contraception in the same way that Democrats are.
sentences.zh: 在国家层面上出来像民主党人那样支持避孕。

sentences.en: You know, some of the support is sort of support by not voicing opposition rather than coming out and saying,
sentences.zh: 你知道，一些支持只是通过不表示反对来体现，而不是站出来说，

sentences.en: this is an issue we want to get behind and we want to really expand contraception access.
sentences.zh: 这是我们想要支持并真正想要扩大避孕获取途径的议题。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Understood.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Pam, I just want to reflect for a moment on what feels like a really remarkable moment that we're in,
sentences.zh: 帕姆，我只是想反思一下我们所处的这个非凡时刻，

sentences.en: which is that at the same time as anti-abortion groups have won this huge victory in overturning Roe versus Wade and abortion access is withering away in many parts of the country,
sentences.zh: 那就是在反堕胎组织在推翻“罗诉韦德案”中取得巨大胜利，且堕胎途径在全国许多地方逐渐消失的同时，

sentences.en: we also have the exact opposite thing happening with the pill.
sentences.zh: 我们也在避孕药方面看到了完全相反的情况。

sentences.en: It's now going to be available over the counter.
sentences.zh: 它现在将成为非处方药。

sentences.en: It just feels hard to understand how these two things are happening at the same time.
sentences.zh: 这让人很难理解这两件事怎么会同时发生。

sentences.en: How do you interpret that?
sentences.zh: 你如何解读这一点？

sentences.en: I think it's the kind of thing that sounds like a huge contradiction, but it's actually very logical when you consider how these issues work kind of together
sentences.zh: 我认为这听起来像是一个巨大的矛盾，但当你考虑到这些议题是如何共同作用，

sentences.en: and how they play off one another.
sentences.zh: 以及它们如何相互影响时，这其实是非常合乎逻辑的。

sentences.en: And so when you have one side having, you know, a big loss in terms of access to abortion,
sentences.zh: 所以当一方在堕胎途径方面遭受了重大损失时，

sentences.en: then you have them really getting energized and throwing everything that they can behind getting a win.
sentences.zh: 他们就会变得非常积极，并全力以赴争取胜利。

sentences.en: You know, so the stakes are very high.
sentences.zh: 你知道，所以赌注非常高。

sentences.en: They are putting everything they can behind getting a win on those stakes.
sentences.zh: 他们正在全力以赴争取在这些赌注上获胜。

sentences.en: And you have a situation where, unlike what we were talking about before, where there was a time when this issue was getting drowned out by a lot of reproductive health issues,
sentences.zh: 而且你面临的情况是，与我们之前谈论的不同，那时这个问题被许多生殖健康问题所淹没，

sentences.en: right now this is actually an issue that people are paying attention to.
sentences.zh: 而现在这实际上是一个人们正在关注的问题。

sentences.en: So the removal of guaranteed access to abortion has made people focus a lot more on other things like contraception.
sentences.zh: 因此，取消堕胎的保障途径使人们更加关注避孕等其他事情。

sentences.en: And so, in a sense, the timing was right for this kind of decision to happen.
sentences.zh: 所以，从某种意义上说，这种决定发生的时机是正确的。

sentences.en: That makes me wonder what's going to happen now.
sentences.zh: 这让我好奇接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: I mean, how transformative do you think this move to make birth control available without a prescription will be for women?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你认为这种将避孕药变为非处方药的举措对女性会有多大的变革意义？

sentences.en: The big question is going to be, how much will this pill cost and will people be able to afford it?
sentences.zh: 最大的问题是，这种药丸的价格是多少，人们是否买得起？

sentences.en: We are waiting for the company to set a price.
sentences.zh: 我们正在等待公司定价。

sentences.en: We're waiting to see whether insurance will be required to cover it.
sentences.zh: 我们正在等待看是否需要保险来覆盖它。

sentences.en: So affordability here is really key.
sentences.zh: 所以负担能力在这里是关键。

sentences.en: If that happens, then I think it will be really transformative because the people who really need this kind of access to the pill
sentences.zh: 如果实现了这一点，那么我认为它将具有真正的变革意义，因为真正需要这种避孕药获取途径的人

sentences.en: are going to be young women, teenagers, women living in poor communities, in rural communities,
sentences.zh: 将是年轻女性、青少年、生活在贫困社区和农村社区的女性，

sentences.en: where it's really challenging to find the time and spend the money to travel to see a doctor or go to a clinic for a prescription.
sentences.zh: 在那里，花时间和金钱去旅行看医生或去诊所开处方是非常困难的。

sentences.en: This pill is going to be available at the gas station, at a convenience store, on just a shelf next to the aspirin, on Amazon.
sentences.zh: 这种药丸将可以在加油站、便利店买到，就在阿司匹林旁边的货架上，或者在亚马逊上买到。

sentences.en: And so if the price is right, I think that will increase access for an awful lot of women.
sentences.zh: 所以如果价格合适，我认为这将增加大量女性的获取途径。

sentences.en: And given where this whole story started in the 1950s, it's really kind of remarkable that we are now in an era where birth control pill can be available right off the shelf.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这个故事在20世纪50年代的起点，我们现在处于一个避孕药可以直接在货架上买到的时代，这确实非常了不起。

sentences.en: Pam, thank you.
sentences.zh: 帕姆，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘（Wynna Liu）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基（Sam Mazursky），我每天负责创作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called Chromesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”（Chromesthesia）的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的消息。

sentences.en: In a sign that former President Donald Trump is likely to be indicted for a third time,
sentences.zh: 有迹象表明前总统唐纳德·特朗普很可能面临第三次起诉，

sentences.en: he has received a letter from the Justice Department saying that he's the target of a federal investigation into his efforts to overturn the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 他收到了一封来自司法部的信，称他是联邦调查的目标，该调查涉及他推翻2020年大选结果的努力。

sentences.en: The letter means that prosecutors have gathered substantial evidence linking Trump to a crime, but it does not guarantee that he will be charged.
sentences.zh: 这封信意味着检察官已经收集了大量将特朗普与犯罪联系起来的证据，但这并不保证他一定会被起诉。

sentences.en: And so far, it's unclear exactly what those charges might be.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，尚不清楚具体指控可能是什么。

sentences.en: Trump repeatedly sought ways to hold on to power after losing the 2020 election, including by making false claims of election fraud,
sentences.zh: 特朗普在输掉2020年大选后多次寻求保住权力的途径，包括散布选举舞弊的虚假声明，

sentences.en: pressuring local officials to find him more votes, and inviting his supporters to march to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 向当地官员施压要求他们为他找到更多选票，并邀请他的支持者在1月6日游行前往美国

sentences.en: Capitol on January 6th.
sentences.zh: 国会大厦。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday, North Korea detained an American soldier who crossed into the country without authorization.
sentences.zh: 周二，朝鲜扣押了一名未经授权越境进入该国的美国士兵。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the soldier was on a tour of the heavily guarded security zone between North and South Korea when he broke away from the tour group and ran across the border.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，这名士兵在参观朝韩之间戒备森严的安全区时，脱离了旅游团并跑过了边境。

sentences.en: The U.S., which has no diplomatic relationship with North Korea, is now working with North Korea's military to negotiate the soldier's release.
sentences.zh: 与朝鲜没有外交关系的美国目前正与朝鲜军方合作，协商释放这名士兵。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Luke Vanderplug, Mooj Zaidi, and Carlos Prieto.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由卢克·范德普鲁格（Luke Vanderplug）、穆吉·扎伊迪（Mooj Zaidi）和卡洛斯·普列托（Carlos Prieto）制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Paige Cowett, contains original music by Marion Lozano, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 由佩奇·考维特（Paige Cowett）编辑，包含玛丽昂·洛萨诺（Marion Lozano）的原创音乐，并由艾丽莎·莫克斯利（Alyssa Moxley）进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsverk of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格（Jim Brunberg）和本·兰兹维克（Ben Landsverk）创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Natalie Kittroweff.
sentences.zh: 我是娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备节日期间的待客之道。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是那种喝断片儿了才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这可是个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们是否有过敏症或食物敏感？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或您常用的播客平台收听《Wirecutter秀》。
